recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. No immediate OO incubator follow-up is indicated by this reconciliation; if future SupplyRequest intent binding work is needed, make it in HL7/oo-incubator rather than inactive core source.
issue_request: FHIR-45453 is an Applied/Persuasive OO change request asking SupplyRequest to follow the Request.intent pattern by using the common RequestIntent value set, rather than a pre-applied SupplyRequest-specific intent value set/code system, so directive and future RequestIntent codes are included consistently.
initial_application: Commit c44e1fb5a83d0e2f4ceed6fa94f5228e1a8b98e2 initially added SupplyRequest.intent with a bespoke supplyrequest-intent binding. Commit 15f50a71de0796cd0db5d1c732b05f221ed7d82c added the related FHIR-20604 immutable intent comment. Commit 92585cc68b2772bc849ff3b123dff45c7d9d4339 deleted the bespoke supplyrequest-intent CodeSystem/ValueSet and rebound SupplyRequest.intent to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-intent; commit 3665eb2b3a881f1f794e98b5838116dd6632265f updated the short code list to include directive.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini no longer has an active SupplyRequest resource registration after commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed SupplyRequest and other OO resources from the core build. The current OO incubator continuous-build StructureDefinition-SupplyRequest.json shows SupplyRequest.intent as 1..1, required, with short including directive and valueSet http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-intent. FHIR-43453 later updated SupplyRequest workflow mappings but did not reverse the intent binding. OO minutes from 2024-05-07 align with the Jira vote/reopen history; no relevant contradictory Zulip messages were found.
reconciliation: No FHIR-core source file was changed. An empty external-repo audit commit was published because SupplyRequest is outside the active FHIR-core build and any future authoritative edits belong in HL7/oo-incubator; the currently published external artifact already reflects the requested binding.
